name: nelua-site
description: spacegho.st/nelua: the Nelua core ecosystem (compiler fork, nelibc, nebox), served as static assets from a Cloudflare Worker.

scripts.build: imba build src/explorer.imba --web --production --bundle --minify --no-sourcemap --outdir build/explorer && imba build src/community/app.imba --web --production --bundle --minify --no-sourcemap --outdir build/community-app && imba build src/community/account.imba --web --production --bundle --minify --no-sourcemap --outdir build/community-account && node scripts/place.mjs && npm run render
